tools.name: roast_idea
tools.description: Get the full whycantwehaveanagentforthis.com roast for an AI agent idea: the verdict tier, an agent-readiness score (0-100 + band), the top OWASP-MCP security risk, the "you're the X% who…" framing, and a shareable /result URL. Every call mints a real, persistent result page (its own OG share card)

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Fetch a verdict that was already minted, by its result id or slug. Read-only — no new analysis, no rate-limit cost. Returns the same structured verdict shape as roast_idea.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Live public numbers for whycantwehaveanagentforthis.com: total ideas roasted, live results, % told to ship, % that already exist, roast battles, and how many roasts came in via MCP. Read-only, no rate-limit cost.

tools.name: browse_explore
tools.description: Page through existing public roasts (the /explore feed) with their shareable /result URLs. Optional free-text query and sort (newest | top | money). Read-only, no rate-limit cost — use it to see whether an idea was already roasted before minting a new one.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: roast_idea, browse_explore · Private data: roast_idea · Public sink: roast_idea.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: roast_idea, browse_explore · Private data: roast_idea · Public sink: roast_idea

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
